1.text: N Solomon tha son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, N tha LORD his God was wit him, N magnified him exceedingly.

But tha ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim 2 tha place which David had prepared 4 it: 4 he had pitched a tent 4 it at Jerusalem.
Moreover tha brasen altar, dat Bezaleel tha son of Uri, tha son of Hur, had made, he put before tha tabernacle of tha LORD: N Solomon N tha congregation sought 2 it.

In dat night did God appear 2 Solomon, N said 2 him, Ask what I shall give u.
N Solomon said 2 God, u have showed great mercy 2 David my father, N have made me 2 reign in his stead.
Now, O LORD God, let ur promise 2 David my father be established: 4 u have made me king over a people like tha dust of tha earth in crowd.
Give me now wisdom N knowledge, dat I may go out N come in before dis people: 4 who can judge dis ur people, dat is so great?

N God said 2 Solomon, Because dis was in thine heart, N u have not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor tha life of thine opps, neither yet have asked long life; but have asked wisdom N knowledge 4 urself, dat u may judge my people, over whom I have made u king:
Wisdom N knowledge is granted 2 u; N I will give u riches, N wealth, N honour, such as none of tha kings have had dat have been before u, neither shall there any after u have tha like.
Then Solomon came from his journey 2 tha high place dat was at Gibeon 2 Jerusalem, from before tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N reigned over Israel.

N dey fetched up, N brought forth out of Egypt a chariot 4 six hundred shekels of silver, N an horse 4 an hundred N fifty: N so brought dey out horses 4 all tha kings of tha Hittites, N 4 tha kings of Syria, by their means.

2.text: N Solomon determined 2 build an house 4 tha name of tha LORD, N an house 4 his kingdom.

N Solomon sent 2 Huram tha king of Tyre, sayin, As u did deal wit David my father, N did send him cedars 2 build him an house 2 live in it, even so deal wit me.

N tha house which I build is great: 4 great is our God above all gods.
But who is able 2 build him an house, seein tha heaven N heaven of heavenz cannot contain him? who am I then, dat I should build him an house, save only 2 burn sacrifice before him?

Send me now therefore a man cunning 2 work in gold, N in silver, N in brass, N in iron, N in purple, N crimson, N blue, N dat can skill 2 grave wit tha cunning men dat r wit me in Judah N in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, N algum trees, out of Lebanon: 4 I know dat ur servants can skill 2 cut timber in Lebanon; N, look, my servants shall be wit ur servants,
Even 2 prepare me timber in abundance: 4 tha house which I am about 2 build shall be wonderful great.

N, look, I will give 2 ur servants, tha hewers dat cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, N twenty thousand measures of barley, N twenty thousand baths of wine, N twenty thousand baths of oil.
Then Huram tha king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent 2 Solomon, Because tha LORD has loved his people, he has made u king over ’em.

Huram said moreover, Blessed be tha LORD God of Israel, dat made heaven N earth, who has given 2 David tha king a wise son, endued wit prudence N understanding, dat might build an house 4 tha LORD, N an house 4 his kingdom.
N now I have sent a cunning man, endued wit understanding, of Huram my father’s,

Tha son of a woman of tha daughters of Dan, N his father was a man of Tyre, skilful 2 work in gold, N in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, N in timber, in purple, in blue, N in fine linen, N in crimson; also 2 grave any manner of graving, N 2 find out every device which shall be put 2 him, wit ur cunning men, N wit tha cunning men of my lord David ur father.
Now therefore tha wheat, N tha barley, tha oil, N tha wine, which my lord has spoken of, let him send 2 his servants:
N we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as u will need: N we will bring it 2 u in floats by sea 2 Joppa; N u will carry it up 2 Jerusalem.

N Solomon numbered all tha strangers dat were in tha land of Israel, after tha numbering wherewith David his father had numbered ’em; N dey were found an hundred N fifty thousand N three thousand N six hundred.

3.text: Then Solomon began 2 build tha house of tha LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where tha Lord appeared 2 David his father, in tha place dat David had prepared in tha threshingfloor of Ornan tha Jebusite.
N he began 2 build in tha second day of tha second month, in tha fourth year of his reign.
Now dese r tha things in which Solomon was instructed 4 tha buildin of tha house of God. tha length by cubits after tha first measure was threescore cubits, N tha breadth twenty cubits.
N tha porch dat was in tha front of tha house, tha length of it was according 2 tha breadth of tha house, twenty cubits, N tha height was an hundred N twenty: N he overlaid it within wit pure gold.
N tha greater house he cieled wit fir tree, which he overlaid wit fine gold, N set thereon palm trees N chains.
N he garnished tha house wit precious stones 4 beauty: N tha gold was gold of Parvaim.
He overlaid also tha house, tha beams, tha posts, N tha walls of it, N tha doors of it, wit gold; N graved cherubims on tha walls.

N he made tha most holy house, tha length whereof was according 2 tha breadth of tha house, twenty cubits, N tha breadth of it twenty cubits: N he overlaid it wit fine gold, amounting 2 six hundred talents.
N tha weight of tha nails was fifty shekels of gold. N he overlaid tha upper chambers wit gold.
N in tha most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, N overlaid ’em wit gold.

N tha wings of tha cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of tha one cherub was five cubits, reaching 2 tha wall of tha house: N tha other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching 2 tha wing of tha other cherub.
N one wing of tha other cherub was five cubits, reaching 2 tha wall of tha house: N tha other wing was five cubits also, joining 2 tha wing of tha other cherub.
Tha wings of dese cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: N dey stood on their feet, N their faces were inward.
N he made tha vail of blue, N purple, N crimson, N fine linen, N wrought cherubims thereon.
Also he made before tha house two pillars of thirty N five cubits high, N tha chapiter dat was on tha top of each of ’em was five cubits.
N he made chains, as in tha oracle, N put ’em on tha heads of tha pillars; N made an hundred pomegranates, N put ’em on tha chains.
N he reared up tha pillars before tha temple, one on tha right hand, N tha other on tha left; N called tha name of dat on tha right hand Jachin, N tha name of dat on tha left Boaz.

4.text: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits tha length of it, N twenty cubits tha breadth of it, N ten cubits tha height of it.

N under it was tha similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing tha sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

It stood upon twelve oxen, three lookin toward tha north, N three lookin toward tha west, N three lookin toward tha south, N three lookin toward tha east: N tha sea was set above upon ’em, N all their hinder parts were inward.
N tha thickness of it was an handbreadth, N tha brim of it like tha work of tha brim of a cup, wit flowers of lilies; N it received N held three thousand baths.
He made also ten lavers, N put five on tha right hand, N five on tha left, 2 wash in ’em: such things as dey offered 4 tha burnt offering dey washed in ’em; but tha sea was 4 tha priests 2 wash in.
N he made ten candlesticks of gold according 2 their form, N set ’em in tha temple, five on tha right hand, N five on tha left.
He made also ten tables, N placed ’em in tha temple, five on tha right side, N five on tha left. N he made an hundred basons of gold.
Furthermore he made tha court of tha priests, N tha great court, N doors 4 tha court, N overlaid tha doors of ’em wit brass.
N he set tha sea on tha right side of tha east end, over against tha south.
N Huram made tha pots, N tha shovels, N tha basons. N Huram finished tha work dat he was 2 make 4 king Solomon 4 tha house of God;
2 wit, tha two pillars, N tha pommels, N tha chapiters which were on tha top of tha two pillars, N tha two wreaths 2 cover tha two pommels of tha chapiters which were on tha top of tha pillars;
N four hundred pomegranates on tha two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, 2 cover tha two pommels of tha chapiters which were upon tha pillars.

Tha pots also, N tha shovels, N tha fleshhooks, N all their instruments, did Huram his father make 2 king Solomon 4 tha house of tha LORD of bright brass.
In tha plain of Jordan did tha king cast ’em, in tha clay ground between Succoth N Zeredathah.
Like dis Solomon made all dese vessels in great abundance: 4 tha weight of tha brass could not be found out.
N Solomon made all tha vessels dat were 4 tha house of God, tha golden altar also, N tha tables whereon tha showbread was set;
Moreover tha candlesticks wit their lamps, dat dey should burn after tha manner before tha oracle, of pure gold;
N tha flowers, N tha lamps, N tha tongs, made he of gold, N dat perfect gold;
N tha snuffers, N tha basons, N tha spoons, N tha censers, of pure gold: N tha entry of tha house, tha inner doors of it 4 tha most holy place, N tha doors of tha house of tha temple, were of gold.

5.text: Like dis all tha work dat Solomon made 4 tha house of tha LORD was finished: N Solomon brought in all tha things dat David his father had dedicated; N tha silver, N tha gold, N all tha instruments, put he among tha treasures of tha house of God.

Then Solomon assembled tha elders of Israel, N all tha heads of tha tribes, tha chief of tha fathers of tha children of Israel, 2 Jerusalem, 2 bring up tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD out of tha city of David, which is Zion.

N dey brought up tha ark, N tha tabernacle of tha congregation, N all tha holy vessels dat were in tha tabernacle, dese did tha priests N tha Levites bring up.

N tha priests brought in tha ark of tha covenant of tha LORD 2 his place, 2 tha oracle of tha house, in2 tha most holy place, even under tha wings of tha cherubims:
4 tha cherubims spread forth their wings over tha place of tha ark, N tha cherubims covered tha ark N tha staves of it above.
N dey drew out tha staves of tha ark, dat tha ends of tha staves were seen from tha ark before tha oracle; but dey were not seen without. N there it is 2 dis day.
There was nothing in tha ark save tha two tables which Moses put in it at Horeb, when tha LORD made a covenant wit tha children of Israel, when dey came out of Egypt.: or, where, etc
N it happened, when tha priests were come out of tha holy place: (4 all tha priests dat were present were sanctified, N did not then wait by course:

Also tha Levites which were tha singers, all of ’em of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, wit their sons N their brothers, bein arrayed in white linen, havin cymbals N psalteries N harps, stood at tha east end of tha altar, N wit ’em an hundred N twenty priests sounding wit trumpets:)

It came even 2 pass, as tha trumpeters N singers were as one, 2 make one sound 2 be heard in praising N thanking tha LORD; N when dey lifted up their voice wit tha trumpets N cymbals N instruments of musick, N praised tha LORD, sayin, 4 he is good; 4 his mercy endures 4 ever: dat then tha house was filled wit a cloud, even tha house of tha LORD;

6.text: Then said Solomon, tha LORD has said dat he would live in tha thick darkness.

N he said, Blessed be tha LORD God of Israel, who has wit his hands fulfilled dat which he spoke wit his mouth 2 my father David, sayin,

But tha LORD said 2 David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart 2 build an house 4 my name, u did well in dat it was in thine heart:
Even so u will not build tha house; but ur son which shall come forth out of ur loins, he shall build tha house 4 my name.

Tha LORD therefore has performed his word dat he has spoken: 4 I am risen up in tha room of David my father, N am set on tha throne of Israel, as tha LORD promised, N have built tha house 4 tha name of tha LORD God of Israel.
N in it have I put tha ark, in which is tha covenant of tha LORD, dat he made wit tha children of Israel.

4 Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, N five cubits broad, N three cubits high, N had set it in tha midst of tha court: N upon it he stood, N kneeled down upon his knees before all tha congregation of Israel, N spread forth his hands toward heaven,
N said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like u in tha heaven, nor in tha earth; which keep covenant, N show mercy 2 ur servants, dat walk before u wit all their hearts:
u which have kept wit ur servant David my father dat which u have promised him; N spoke wit ur mouth, N have fulfilled it wit thine hand, as it is dis day.

Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep wit ur servant David my father dat which u have promised him, sayin, There shall not fail u a man in my sight 2 sit upon tha throne of Israel; yet so dat ur children pay attention 2 their way 2 walk in my law, as u have walked before me.
Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let ur word be verified, which u have spoken 2 ur servant David.
But will God in very deed live wit men on tha earth? look, heaven N tha heaven of heavenz cannot contain u; how much less dis house which I have built!
Have respect therefore 2 tha prayer of ur servant, N 2 his supplication, O LORD my God, 2 listen 2 tha cry N tha prayer which ur servant prays before u:
Dat ur eyes may be open upon dis house day N night, upon tha place whereof u have said dat u would put ur name there; 2 listen 2 tha prayer which ur servant prays toward dis place.
Listen therefore 2 tha supplications of ur servant, N of ur people Israel, which dey shall make toward dis place: hear u from ur livin place, even from heaven; N when u hear, forgive.
If a man sin against his neighbour, N an oath be laid upon him 2 make him swear, N tha oath come before thine altar in dis house;

N if ur people Israel be put 2 tha worse before tha opp, because dey have sinned against u; N shall return N confess ur name, N pray N make supplication before u in dis house;

When tha heaven is shut up, N there is no rain, because dey have sinned against u; yet if dey pray toward dis place, N confess ur name, N turn from their sin, when u do afflict ’em;

Then hear u from heaven, N forgive tha sin of ur servants, N of ur people Israel, when u have taught ’em tha good way, in which dey should walk; N send rain upon ur land, which u have given 2 ur people 4 an inheritance.

If there be dearth in tha land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their opps besiege ’em in tha citiez of their land; whatever sore or whatever sickness there be:
Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all ur people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore N his own grief, N shall spread forth his hands in dis house:
Then hear u from heaven ur livin place, N forgive, N render 2 every man according 2 all his ways, whose heart u know; (4 u only know tha hearts of tha children of men:)
Dat dey may fear u, 2 walk in ur ways, so long as dey live in tha land which u gave 2 our fathers.
Moreover concerning tha stranger, which is not of ur people Israel, but is come from a far country 4 ur great name’s sake, N ur mighty hand, N ur stretched out arm; if dey come N pray in dis house;

Then hear u from tha heavenz, even from ur livin place, N do according 2 all dat tha stranger calls 2 u 4; dat all people of tha earth may know ur name, N fear u, as does ur people Israel, N may know dat dis house which I have built is called by ur name.

Yet if dey bethink themselves in tha land where dey r carried captive, N turn N pray 2 u in tha land of their captivity, sayin, We have sinned, we have done amiss, N have dealt wickedly;

If dey return 2 u wit all their heart N wit all their soul in tha land of their captivity, where dey have carried ’em captives, N pray toward their land, which u gave 2 their fathers, N toward tha city which u have chosen, N toward tha house which I have built 4 ur name:
Then hear u from tha heavenz, even from ur livin place, their prayer N their supplications, N maintain their cause, N forgive ur people which have sinned against u.
Now, my God, let, I beg u, ur eyes be open, N let thine ears be attent 2 tha prayer dat is made in dis place.
Now therefore arise, O LORD God, in2 ur resting place, u, N tha ark of ur strength: let ur priests, O LORD God, be clothed wit salvation, N let ur saints rejoice in goodness.

N say, like dis says tha king, Put dis fellow in tha prison, N feed him wit bread of affliction N wit water of affliction, until I return in peace.
N Micaiah said, If u certainly return in peace, then has not tha LORD spoken by me. N he said, listen, all y’all people.
So tha king of Israel N Jehoshaphat tha king of Judah went up 2 Ramoth-gilead.
N tha king of Israel said 2 Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, N will go 2 tha battle; but put u on ur robes. So tha king of Israel disguised himself; N dey went 2 tha battle.
Now tha king of Syria had commanded tha captains of tha chariots dat were wit him, sayin, Fight y’all not wit small or great, save only wit tha king of Israel.

N it happened, when tha captains of tha chariots saw Jehoshaphat, dat dey said, It is tha king of Israel. Therefore dey compassed about him 2 fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, N tha LORD helped him; N God moved ’em 2 depart from him.
4 it happened, dat, when tha captains of tha chariots perceived dat it was not tha king of Israel, dey turned back again from pursuing him.

N a certain man drew a bow at a venture, N struck tha king of Israel between tha joints of tha harness: therefore he said 2 his chariot man, Turn thine hand, dat u may carry me out of tha host; 4 I am wounded.
N tha battle increased dat day: but tha king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against tha Syrians until tha even: N about tha time of tha sun goin down he died.

19.text: N Jehoshaphat tha king of Judah returned 2 his house in peace 2 Jerusalem.
N Jehu tha son of Hanani tha seer went out 2 meet him, N said 2 king Jehoshaphat, should u help tha ungodly, N love ’em dat hate tha LORD? therefore is wrath upon u from before tha LORD.
Nevertheless there r good things found in u, in dat u have taken away tha groves out of tha land, N have prepared thine heart 2 seek God.
N Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem: N he went out again through tha people from Beer-sheba 2 mount Ephraim, N brought ’em back 2 tha LORD God of their fathers.
N he set judges in tha land throughout all tha fenced citiez of Judah, city by city,
N said 2 tha judges, pay attention what y’all do: 4 y’all judge not 4 man, but 4 tha LORD, who is wit u in tha judgment.
So now let tha fear of tha LORD be upon u; pay attention N do it: 4 there is no iniquity wit tha LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor takin of gifts.
Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of tha Levites, N of tha priests, N of tha chief of tha fathers of Israel, 4 tha judgment of tha LORD, N 4 controversies, when dey returned 2 Jerusalem.
N he charged ’em, sayin, like dis shall y’all do in tha fear of tha LORD, faithfully, N wit a perfect heart.

N what cause soever shall come 2 u of ur brothers dat live in their citiez, between blood N blood, between law N commandment, statutes N judgments, y’all shall even warn ’em dat dey trespass not against tha LORD, N so wrath come upon u, N upon ur brothers: dis do, N y’all shall not trespass.

N, look, Amariah tha chief priest is over u in all matters of tha LORD; N Zebadiah tha son of Ishmael, tha ruler of tha house of Judah, 4 all tha king’s matters: also tha Levites shall be officers before u. Deal courageously, N tha LORD shall be wit tha good.

20.text: It happened after dis also, dat tha children of Moab, N tha children of Ammon, N wit ’em other beside tha Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat 2 battle.
Then there came some dat told Jehoshaphat, sayin, There comes a great crowd against u from beyond tha sea on dis side Syria; N, look, dey be in Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.
N Jehoshaphat feared, N set himself 2 seek tha LORD, N proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
N Judah gathered themselves together, 2 ask help of tha LORD: even out of all tha citiez of Judah dey came 2 seek tha LORD.
N Jehoshaphat stood in tha congregation of Judah N Jerusalem, in tha house of tha LORD, before tha new court,
N said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not u God in heaven? N rule not u over all tha kingdoms of tha heathen? N in thine hand is there not power N might, so dat none is able 2 withstand u?
Art not u our God, who did drive out tha inhabitants of dis land before ur people Israel, N gave it 2 tha seed of Abraham ur friend 4 ever?
N dey lived in it, N have built u a sanctuary in it 4 ur name, sayin,

If, when evil comes upon us, as tha sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before dis house, N in ur presence, (4 ur name is in dis house,) N cry 2 u in our affliction, then u will hear N help.
N now, look, tha children of Ammon N Moab N mount Seir, whom u would not let Israel invade, when dey came out of tha land of Egypt, but dey turned from ’em, N destroyed ’em not;
Look, I say, how dey reward us, 2 come 2 cast us out of ur possession, which u have given us 2 inherit.
O our God, will u not judge ’em? 4 we have no might against dis great company dat comes against us; neither know we what 2 do: but our eyes r upon u.
N all Judah stood before tha LORD, wit their little ones, their wives, N their children.
Then upon Jahaziel tha son of Zechariah, tha son of Benaiah, tha son of Jeiel, tha son of Mattaniah, a Levite of tha sons of Asaph, came tha Spirit of tha LORD in tha midst of tha congregation;

N he said, listen y’all, all Judah, N y’all inhabitants of Jerusalem, N u king Jehoshaphat, like dis says tha LORD 2 u, don’t be afraid nor dismayed by reason of dis great crowd; 4 tha battle is not urz, but God’s.
2 morrow go y’all down against ’em: look, dey come up by tha cliff of Ziz; N y’all shall find ’em at tha end of tha brook, before tha wilderness of Jeruel.

y’all shall not need 2 fight in dis battle: set y’all, stand y’all still, N see tha salvation of tha LORD wit u, O Judah N Jerusalem: don’t fear, nor be dismayed; 2 morrow go out against ’em: 4 tha LORD will be wit u.
N Jehoshaphat bowed his head wit his face 2 tha ground: N all Judah N tha inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before tha LORD, worshippin tha LORD.
N tha Levites, of tha children of tha Kohathites, N of tha children of tha Korhites, stood up 2 praise tha LORD God of Israel wit a loud voice on high.

N dey rose early in tha morning, N went forth in2 tha wilderness of Tekoa: N as dey went forth, Jehoshaphat stood N said, Hear me, O Judah, N y’all inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in tha LORD ur God, so shall y’all be established; believe his prophets, so shall y’all prosper.

N when he had consulted wit tha people, he appointed singers 2 tha LORD, N dat should praise tha beauty of holiness, as dey went out before tha army, N 2 say, Praise tha LORD; 4 his mercy endures 4 ever.
N when dey began 2 sing N 2 praise, tha LORD set ambushments against tha children of Ammon, Moab, N mount Seir, which were come against Judah; N dey were struck.
4 tha children of Ammon N Moab stood up against tha inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly 2 kill N destroy ’em: N when dey had made an end of tha inhabitants of Seir, every one helped 2 destroy another.
N when Judah came toward tha watch tower in tha wilderness, dey looked 2 tha crowd, N, look, dey were dead bodies fallen 2 tha earth, N none escaped.

N when Jehoshaphat N his people came 2 take away tha spoil of ’em, dey found among ’em in abundance both riches wit tha dead bodies, N precious jewels, which dey stripped off 4 themselves, more than dey could carry away: N dey were three days in gatherin of tha spoil, it was so much.
N on tha fourth day dey assembled themselves in tha valley of Berachah; 4 there dey blessed tha LORD: therefore tha name of tha same place was called, tha valley of Berachah, 2 dis day.
Then dey returned, every man of Judah N Jerusalem, N Jehoshaphat in tha forefront of ’em, 2 go again 2 Jerusalem wit joy; 4 tha LORD had made ’em 2 rejoice over their opps.
N dey came 2 Jerusalem wit psalteries N harps N trumpets 2 tha house of tha LORD.
N tha fear of God was on all tha kingdoms of dose countries, when dey had heard dat tha LORD fought against tha opps of Israel.
So tha realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: 4 his God gave him rest round about.
N Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty N five years old when he began 2 reign, N he reigned twenty N five years in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Azubah tha daughter of Shilhi.
N he walked in tha way of Asa his father, N departed not from it, doin dat which was right in tha sight of tha LORD.
But tha high places were not taken away: 4 as yet tha people had not prepared their hearts 2 tha God of their fathers.
Now tha rest of tha acts of Jehoshaphat, first N last, look, dey r written in tha book of Jehu tha son of Hanani, who is mentioned in tha book of tha kings of Israel.
N after dis did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself wit Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
N he joined himself wit him 2 make ships 2 go 2 Tarshish: N dey made tha ships in Ezion-geber.

Then Eliezer tha son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, sayin, Because u have joined urself wit Ahaziah, tha LORD has broken ur works. N tha ships were broken, dat dey were not able 2 go 2 Tarshish.

21.text: Now Jehoshaphat slept wit his fathers, N was buried wit his fathers in tha city of David. N Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

Now when Jehoram was risen up 2 tha kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, N killed all his brothers wit tha sword, N divers also of tha princes of Israel.
Jehoram was thirty N two years old when he began 2 reign, N he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
N he walked in tha way of tha kings of Israel, like as did tha house of Ahab: 4 he had tha daughter of Ahab 2 wife: N he wrought dat which was evil in tha eyes of tha LORD.
But tha LORD would not destroy tha house of David, because of tha covenant dat he had made wit David, N as he promised 2 give a light 2 him N 2 his sons 4 ever.
In his days tha Edomites revolted from under tha dominion of Judah, N made themselves a king.
Then Jehoram went forth wit his princes, N all his chariots wit him: N he rose up by night, N struck tha Edomites which compassed him in, N tha captains of tha chariots.

Moreover he made high places in tha mountains of Judah, N caused tha inhabitants of Jerusalem 2 commit fornication, N compelled Judah thereto.

N there came a writing 2 him from Elijah tha prophet, sayin, like dis says tha LORD God of David ur father, Because u have not walked in tha ways of Jehoshaphat ur father, nor in tha ways of Asa king of Judah,

But have walked in tha way of tha kings of Israel, N have made Judah N tha inhabitants of Jerusalem 2 go a whoring, like 2 tha whoredoms of tha house of Ahab, N also have killed ur brothers of ur father’s house, which were better than urself:
Look, wit a great plague will tha LORD strike ur people, N ur children, N ur wives, N all ur goods:
N u will have great sickness by disease of ur bowels, until ur bowels fall out by reason of tha sickness day by day.
Moreover tha LORD stirred up against Jehoram tha spirit of tha Philistines, N of tha Arabians, dat were near tha Ethiopians:

N dey came up in2 Judah, N broke in2 it, N carried away all tha substance dat was found in tha king’s house, N his sons also, N his wives; so dat there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, tha youngest of his sons.
N after all dis tha LORD struck him in his bowels wit an incurable disease.

N it happened, dat in process of time, after tha end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. N his people made no burnin 4 him, like tha burnin of his fathers.

22.text: N tha inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: 4 tha band of men dat came wit tha Arabians 2 tha camp had killed all tha eldest. So Ahaziah tha son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
Forty N two years old was Ahaziah when he began 2 reign, N he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Athaliah tha daughter of Omri.

So he did evil in tha sight of tha LORD like tha house of Ahab: 4 dey were his counsellors after tha death of his father 2 his destruction.
He walked also after their counsel, N went wit Jehoram tha son of Ahab king of Israel 2 war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: N tha Syrians struck Joram.

N he returned 2 be healed in Jezreel because of tha wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought wit Hazael king of Syria. N Azariah tha son of Jehoram king of Judah went down 2 see Jehoram tha son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
N tha destruction of Ahaziah was of God by comin 2 Joram: 4 when he was come, he went out wit Jehoram against Jehu tha son of Nimshi, whom tha LORD had anointed 2 cut off tha house of Ahab.
N it happened, dat, when Jehu was executing judgment upon tha house of Ahab, N found tha princes of Judah, N tha sons of tha brothers of Ahaziah, dat ministered 2 Ahaziah, he killed ’em.

N he sought Ahaziah: N dey caught him, (4 he was hid in Samaria,) N brought him 2 Jehu: N when dey had killed him, dey buried him: Because, said dey, he is tha son of Jehoshaphat, who sought tha LORD wit all his heart. So tha house of Ahaziah had no power 2 keep still tha kingdom.
But when Athaliah tha mother of Ahaziah saw dat her son was dead, she arose N destroyed all tha seed royal of tha house of Judah.

But Jehoshabeath, tha daughter of tha king, took Joash tha son of Ahaziah, N stole him from among tha king’s sons dat were killed, N put him N his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, tha daughter of king Jehoram, tha wife of Jehoiada tha priest, (4 she was tha sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so dat she killed him not.
N he was wit ’em hid in tha house of God six years: N Athaliah reigned over tha land.

23.text: N in tha seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, N took tha captains of hundreds, Azariah tha son of Jeroham, N Ishmael tha son of Jehohanan, N Azariah tha son of Obed, N Maaseiah tha son of Adaiah, N Elishaphat tha son of Zichri, in2 covenant wit him.
N dey went about in Judah, N gathered tha Levites out of all tha citiez of Judah, N tha chief of tha fathers of Israel, N dey came 2 Jerusalem.
N all tha congregation made a covenant wit tha king in tha house of God. N he said 2 ’em, look, tha king’s son shall reign, as tha LORD has said of tha sons of David.
Dis is tha thing dat y’all shall do; A third part of u entering on tha sabbath, of tha priests N of tha Levites, shall be porters of tha doors;
N a third part shall be at tha king’s house; N a third part at tha gate of tha foundation: N all tha people shall be in tha courts of tha house of tha LORD.
But let none come in2 tha house of tha LORD, save tha priests, N dey dat minister of tha Levites; dey shall go in, 4 dey r holy: but all tha people shall keep tha watch of tha LORD.

Moreover Jehoiada tha priest delivered 2 tha captains of hundreds spears, N bucklers, N shields, dat had been king David’s, which were in tha house of God.
N he set all tha people, every man havin his weapon in his hand, from tha right side of tha temple 2 tha left side of tha temple, along by tha altar N tha temple, by tha king round about.
Then dey brought out tha king’s son, N put upon him tha crown, N gave him tha testimony, N made him king. N Jehoiada N his sons anointed him, N said, God save tha king.
Now when Athaliah heard tha noise of tha people runnin N praising tha king, she came 2 tha people in2 tha house of tha LORD:

N she looked, N, look, tha king stood at his pillar at tha entering in, N tha princes N tha trumpets by tha king: N all tha people of tha land rejoiced, N sounded wit trumpets, also tha singers wit instruments of musick, N such as taught 2 sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, N said, Treason, Treason.

Then Jehoiada tha priest brought out tha captains of hundreds dat were set over tha host, N said 2 ’em, Have her forth of tha ranges: N whoever follows her, let him be killed wit tha sword. 4 tha priest said, kill her not in tha house of tha LORD.
So dey laid hands on her; N when she was come 2 tha entering of tha horse gate by tha king’s house, dey killed her there.
N Jehoiada made a covenant between him, N between all tha people, N between tha king, dat dey should be tha LORD’s people.
Then all tha people went 2 tha house of Baal, N broke it down, N broke his altars N his images in pieces, N killed Mattan tha priest of Baal before tha altars.

Also Jehoiada appointed tha offices of tha house of tha LORD by tha hand of tha priests tha Levites, whom David had distributed in tha house of tha LORD, 2 offer tha burnt offerings of tha LORD, as it is written in tha law of Moses, wit rejoicin N wit singin, as it was ordained by David.

N he took tha captains of hundreds, N tha nobles, N tha governors of tha people, N all tha people of tha land, N brought down tha king from tha house of tha LORD: N dey came through tha high gate in2 tha king’s house, N set tha king upon tha throne of tha kingdom.
N all tha people of tha land rejoiced: N tha city was quiet, after dat dey had killed Athaliah wit tha sword.

24.text: Joash was seven years old when he began 2 reign, N he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

N tha king called 4 Jehoiada tha chief, N said 2 him, Why have u not required of tha Levites 2 bring in out of Judah N out of Jerusalem tha collection, according 2 tha commandment of Moses tha servant of tha LORD, N of tha congregation of Israel, 4 tha tabernacle of witness?
4 tha sons of Athaliah, dat wicked woman, had broken up tha house of God; N also all tha dedicated things of tha house of tha LORD did dey bestow upon Baalim.

N dey made a proclamation through Judah N Jerusalem, 2 bring in 2 tha LORD tha collection dat Moses tha servant of God laid upon Israel in tha wilderness.
N all tha princes N all tha people rejoiced, N brought in, N cast in2 tha chest, until dey had made an end.

N tha king N Jehoiada gave it 2 such as did tha work of tha service of tha house of tha LORD, N hired masons N carpenters 2 repair tha house of tha LORD, N also such as wrought iron N brass 2 mend tha house of tha LORD.
So tha workmen wrought, N tha work was perfected by ’em, N dey set tha house of God in his state, N strengthened it.

N when dey had finished it, dey brought tha rest of tha money before tha king N Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels 4 tha house of tha LORD, even vessels 2 minister, N 2 offer withal, N spoons, N vessels of gold N silver. N dey offered burnt offerings in tha house of tha LORD continually all tha days of Jehoiada.
But Jehoiada grew old, N was full of days when he died; an hundred N thirty years old was he when he died.
N dey buried him in tha city of David among tha kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, N toward his house.
Now after tha death of Jehoiada came tha princes of Judah, N made obeisance 2 tha king. Then tha king listened 2 ’em.
N dey left tha house of tha LORD God of their fathers, N served groves N idols: N wrath came upon Judah N Jerusalem 4 dis their trespass.
Yet he sent prophets 2 ’em, 2 bring ’em again 2 tha LORD; N dey testified against ’em: but dey would not listen up.

N tha Spirit of God came upon Zechariah tha son of Jehoiada tha priest, which stood above tha people, N said 2 ’em, like dis says God, Why transgress y’all tha commandments of tha LORD, dat y’all cannot prosper? because y’all have forsaken tha LORD, he has also forsaken u.
N dey conspired against him, N stoned him wit stones at tha commandment of tha king in tha court of tha house of tha LORD.
Like dis Joash tha king remembered not tha kindness which Jehoiada his father had done 2 him, but killed his son. N when he died, he said, tha LORD look upon it, N require it.

N it happened at tha end of tha year, dat tha host of Syria came up against him: N dey came 2 Judah N Jerusalem, N destroyed all tha princes of tha people from among tha people, N sent all tha spoil of ’em 2 tha king of Damascus.

4 tha army of tha Syrians came wit a small company of men, N tha LORD delivered a very great host in2 their hand, because dey had forsaken tha LORD God of their fathers. So dey executed judgment against Joash.

N when dey were departed from him, (4 dey left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him 4 tha blood of tha sons of Jehoiada tha priest, N killed him on his bed, N he died: N dey buried him in tha city of David, but dey buried him not in tha sepulchres of tha kings.
N dese r dey dat conspired against him; Zabad tha son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, N Jehozabad tha son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

Now concerning his sons, N tha greatness of tha burdens laid upon him, N tha repairing of tha house of God, look, dey r written in tha story of tha book of tha kings. N Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

25.text: Amaziah was twenty N five years old when he began 2 reign, N he reigned twenty N nine years in Jerusalem. N his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
N he did dat which was right in tha sight of tha LORD, but not wit a perfect heart.

But he killed not their children, but did as it is written in tha law in tha book of Moses, where tha LORD commanded, sayin, tha fathers shall not die 4 tha children, neither shall tha children die 4 tha fathers, but every man shall die 4 his own sin.

N Amaziah strengthened himself, N led forth his people, N went 2 tha valley of salt, N struck of tha children of Seir ten thousand.
N other ten thousand left alive did tha children of Judah carry away captive, N brought ’em 2 tha top of tha rock, N cast ’em down from tha top of tha rock, dat dey all were broken in pieces.

But tha soldiers of tha army which Amaziah sent back, dat dey should not go wit him 2 battle, fell upon tha citiez of Judah, from Samaria even 2 Beth-horon, N struck three thousand of ’em, N took much spoil.

Now it happened, after dat Amaziah was come from tha slaughter of tha Edomites, dat he brought tha gods of tha children of Seir, N set ’em up 2 be his gods, N bowed down himself before ’em, N burned incense 2 ’em.

So tha anger of tha LORD was kindled against Amaziah, N he sent 2 him a prophet, which said 2 him, Why have u sought after tha gods of tha people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?

N it happened, as he talked wit him, dat tha king said 2 him, r u made of tha king’s counsel? forbear; why should u be struck? Then tha prophet forbare, N said, I know dat God has determined 2 destroy u, because u have done dis, N have not listened 2 my counsel.
Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, N sent 2 Joash, tha son of Jehoahaz, tha son of Jehu, king of Israel, sayin, Come, let us see one another in tha face.

N Joash king of Israel sent 2 Amaziah king of Judah, sayin, tha thistle dat was in Lebanon sent 2 tha cedar dat was in Lebanon, sayin, Give ur daughter 2 my son 2 wife: N there passed by a wild beast dat was in Lebanon, N trode down tha thistle.
u sayest, look, u have struck tha Edomites; N thine heart lifts u up 2 boast: abide now at home; why should u meddle 2 thine hurt, dat u should fall, even u, N Judah wit u?
But Amaziah would not hear; 4 it came of God, dat he might deliver ’em in2 tha hand of their opps, because dey sought after tha gods of Edom.
So Joash tha king of Israel went up; N dey saw one another in tha face, both he N Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongs 2 Judah.
